BETWEEN:-
 BHANU PRATAP SINGH S/O TODAL PRATAP SINGH  LODHI, AGED ABOUT 40 YEARS, OCCUPATION:
 AGRICULTURIST RESIDENT OF VILLAGE BARKHEDA  BAIS P.S. PATERA DISTRICT DAMOH (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI R.P. THAKUR - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION HATA DISTRICT DAMOH (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI C.K. MISHRA - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 o f the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to F.I.R. No.403/2022, dated 12.09.2022, registered at Police Station Hata District - Damoh for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B/34, 201 of IPC.

He is in detention since 18.04.2023.
2.

As per the prosecution story, on 22.7.2022, Bhanu Pratap Lodhi approached Bhanukumar Badkul and informed him that Vishal Singh who is owner of agricultural land bearing Khasra No.397/1 admeasuring 4.60 Hectare, is his cousin and Vishal wish to sale the same.
Applicant told him to call the real owner of land.
Bhanu Pratap Singh Lodhi came along with one person and introduced him as Vishal Singh, owner of the land.

He along with them visited the spot but without making any verification about the actual owner of the land, purchased the said land in the name of his wife Smt.
Sarojrani Jain and his sister Smt. Sushma Jain.

Consideration of sale was paid by him to said Vishal Bhanu Pratap Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47026493/
1 Singh.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Later a complaint was made that Bhanu Pratap has taken the entire sale consideration from the so called Vishal Singh.

In investigation it was found that the person, who had executed the sale deed was not real owner Vishal Singh but someone else impersonating himself as Vishal Singh owner of the land and extended sale deeds fraudulently.
F.I.R. was registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He himself has been cheated by so called Vishal Singh.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail, pending trial.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail to the applicant.
5 . After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Bhanu Pratap Singh be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Jasleen Bhanu Pratap Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47026493/
